title: Roast chicken without certification details
notes: Looks like ordinary food, but kosher status still depends on slaughter, certification, and kitchen status.
dishes: Roasted chicken with salt, pepper, and olive oil, cooked at home. No kosher certification is mentioned.
criteria: Do not treat an ordinary chicken dish as automatically KOSHER.
Ask about or mention certification, slaughter, or kitchen conditions.
Do not present the answer as a final religious ruling.
